1879-4289-4770-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

643-728-3951-5703.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
643-728-3951-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

1170-2921-5131-7753--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2921-5131-7753--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Valeria Richards.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat.

2738-2921-4871-6887.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, The Skullspore Nexus, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Repeat.

455-2060-7889.description:
Cast Hoverguard Sweepers by paying its mana cost.
Dancing from Dark to Dawn's first ability triggers, putting eight +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Hoverguard Sweepers spell. When it enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler eight times by removing eight +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}{U}{U}.
Repeat.

3457-4747-7791.notablePrerequisites: You had a creature with power 2 or greater enter the battlefield this turn.
3457-4747-7791.description:
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Alena.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Alena.
Repeat.

1251-4149-4599-4871-6019.description:
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating six 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing a Zombie token and Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When the Zombie and Ghoulcaller Gisa die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve Scourge of Nel Toth.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping Scourge of Nel Toth and four other Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller GIsa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

546-4499-4613-7231.notablePrerequisites: There are at least five creature cards in all graveyards.
546-4499-4613-7231.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Drakestown Forgotten. Drakestown Forgotten enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
Activate Drakestown Forgotten using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more oil counters on it

3120-3368-6974.description:
Cast Ashling's Command by paying {U}{R} due to Mindsplice Apparatus. Choose its fourth mode targeting yourself and then any other mode as desired.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {R}{R} due to Mindsplice Apparatus, copying Ashling's Command with the fourth mode targeting yourself and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Ashling's Command, creating two Treasure tokens and performing the action of the other chosen mode.
Holding priority, activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

4452-4508-6847.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
4452-4508-6847.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Weftstalker Ardent triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Weftstalker Ardent is a Pirate due to Rukarumel, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Weftstalker Ardent triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Weftstalker Ardent trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

1537-2034-4679-6821.description:
Cast Jump Scare by paying {W}, targeting Zealous Conscripts.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Zealous Conscripts.
When the Zealous Conscripts token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Zealous Conscripts token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

3532-5078-6709-6769.easyPrerequisites:
Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
There are at least two counters on creatures you control.
3532-5078-6709-6769.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Surge Conductor triggers, putting a counter on a creature you control that already has a counter on it.
Repeat.

1235-2743-6231.manaNeeded: {2}{U} plus enough mana to cast the copy spell
1235-2743-6231.notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
1235-2743-6231.description:
Activate Thunderclap Drake by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing it.
Cast Twinflame by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Thunderclap Drake triggers, copying Twinflame at least twice, with all copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Twinflame spells, creating at least three copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers, causing you to win the game.

474-2034-4192-4394.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, putting it under or over a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Specimen Collector, adding {C}{C}.
When Specimen Collector dies, its second ability triggers, creating a copy of the Feather token.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Specimen Collector from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Specimen Collector enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 0/3 Crab creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

1003-2640-4050-6290.description:
Cast Lightwheel Enhancements either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {W}, attaching it to Phyrexian Walker.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, adding {W}.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Dawn Evangel triggers, returning Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Repeat.

3604-5226-5365.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Clue token.
3604-5226-5365.description:
Cast Lonis by paying {1}{G/U}{G/U}.
When Lonis enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Lonis.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat from step 3.
3604-5226-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

63-1563-4231-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Wernog.
Wernog leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, causing you to create at least two Clue, two Treasure, and two Food artifact tokens.
Activate three of the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

4365-4636-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

2793-2921-5483.description:
During your end step, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus.
Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Esoteric Duplicator triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Ugin's Nexus at the beginning of your next end step.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your end step, Esoteric Duplicator triggers, creating a token copy of Ugin's Nexus.
Repeat.

38-5113-5220.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Skirk Prospector on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying {R}.
Repeat.

997-1462-1748.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
997-1462-1748.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing an additional creature.
When the creature dies as an enchantment due to Enchanted Evening, Warehouse Tabby triggers, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

579-913-3525-3793.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Apprentice Wizard.
Apprentice Wizard does not have summoning sickness.
579-913-3525-3793.description:
Activate Apprentice Wizard by paying {U} and tapping it, adding six {C}.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Apprentice Wizard.
Repeat.

1558-2215-4231.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by at least one opponent.
1558-2215-4231.description:
Attack with a creatue you control.
When that creature deals combat damage to an opponent, Grim Hireling triggers.
Resolve the Grim Hireling trigger, creating two Treasure tokens, two Food tokens, and two Clue tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by sacrificing five of the created artifacts and tapping it to take an extra turn.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

646-1172-4691.description:
Cast Channel by paying {G}{G}.
Use Channel's ability by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
When you lose life, Vilis triggers.
In response, activate Words of Worship by paying {1}, creating a replacement effect.
Resolve the Vilis trigger, causing you to gain 5 life instead of drawing a card due to the replacement effect.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
Once you have gained an arbitrarily high amount of life, you may use Channel's ability any number of times, adding colorless mana and drawing cards with Vilis.
Once you have drawn your library, you will have {C} for each card drawn this way.
You can then continue to use Channel, adding infinite {C}, as long as you have drawn a way to remove Vilis or can use the mana to win at instant speed before Vilis's triggers resolve and cause you to lose by drawing from an empty library.
